limitations: Development data already consulted, not independent validation. No combined strategy or operational configuration is promoted.
Costs are scenario models; account quotes do not prove historical fills/spreads/slippage. Minimum notional remains unknown.
Risk-sized reference differs from the old fixed-10-USDT reference: lower total losses alone do not prove economic improvement.
Funnel counts overlap; leave-one-filter-out counts explain intersection, not causal value or independent trades.
Capital-time totals use whole held candles, not exact exchange fill times. Bars with stop and target use pessimistic stop precedence.
